summary: The parts of a picture a finder watches, drawn over it: regions as tinted shapes and tripwires as lines, each in its tone and named; a viewer picks one, reshapes it by its corners, or draws a new one point by point.

anatomy.container: A layer over the picture, taking no presses itself; inside a video player's picture it moves with the view.
anatomy.region: A closed shape through its points (in shares of the picture), filled in its tone at 12 percent and stroked 2 wide in it; picked, filled at 25 percent and stroked 3 wide.
anatomy.line: A line through its points, 2 wide in its tone, dashed 6 on and 4 off; picked, solid and 3 wide.
anatomy.name: The zone's name over its first point, 4 above it: text.2xs 500 in terminal-foreground on terminal/80, padded 4 across, rounded by radius-mini.
anatomy.handle: With onChange, on each corner of the picked zone: a dot 12 across in terminal-foreground ringed 2 wide in terminal, centered on the corner.
anatomy.draw: With draw: a layer over the whole picture taking presses, a crosshair pointer, the hint at its bottom start (as the name's chip), each point added a dot 8 across in primary, and the path so far dashed 4 on and 3 off in primary.

zones.does: Each zone: its id, name, kind (region or line), points and tone.

onSelect.does: Makes each zone pressable: a press picks it, or lets the picked one go.

onChange.does: Makes the picked zone's corners handles to drag or move with the arrow keys.

draw.does: Draws a new zone of this kind, point by point.

onDrawn.does: Called with a drawn zone's points once it has enough: three for a region, two for a line.

onDrawCancel.does: Called when drawing is given up.

selected.means: The zone picked: heavier, its handles shown with onChange.

drawing.means: A new zone being drawn: presses add points.

focus.means: Keyboard focus on a handle or the drawing layer: the focus ring.

rest.note: In its tone: primary, warning or critical.

keyboard.does: Reaches each handle of the picked zone in turn, or the drawing layer.
Moves the corner a hundredth of the picture; with Shift, five.
Gives up the zone being drawn.

words.drawing: Click to add points, then press Enter to finish

drawing.en: Click to add points, then press Enter to finish
